metadata.source: PSOC - Kerberos spn request using GetUserSPNs.py script.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Kerberos spn request using GetUserSPNs.py script
properties.query:
//detect Kerberos spn requests
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4769
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="ServiceName">' ServiceName '</Data>' *
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">' TicketEncryptionType '</Data>' *
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="Status">' Status '</Data>' *
| parse EventData with * '<Data Name="TicketOptions">' TicketOptions '</Data>' *
| where not(ServiceName matches regex @"(?i)^krbtgt$" or ServiceName matches regex @".*\$$")
| where TicketEncryptionType == "0x17"
| where Status == "0x0"
| where TicketOptions == "0x40810010"
| extend
    ComputerName = tostring(column_ifexists("Computer", "")),
    Account = tostring(
        coalesce(
            column_ifexists("SubjectUserName", ""),
            column_ifexists("Account", "")
        )
    ),
    CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("ServiceFileName", ""))
